decided: Allowing the AI to run reviews unasked covers only reviews by this AI, whether in the session or by a clean copy of itself; a review by an outside AI service, alone or as half of a blind pair, needs its own separate permission.
alternatives: one permission covering every kind of review
why: A review by an outside service costs money and sends the project to that service, so allowing reviews in general must not quietly allow it.

defines.definition: two reviews of the same work run together and kept apart from each other: one by a clean copy of this AI, one by an outside AI service
